title: Demo-Man
description:
Explosions is your way of life.
Use explosions in Minecrafts.
Origins 1.20.2
body:
**[Demo-man]**
-----
Impact: ⚪ ⚫ ⚫ 
------
*Explosions is your way of life.*
-----------------------
 - **Actives** ⬆️
-----------------------
 - **Charged**: You have the ability to charge yourself with TNT and explode it all at once. [Secondary]
 - **Homing Launcher**: You can craft and use a Homing Launcher to remotely control tnt. [Sneak + Primary]
 - **TNT Launcher**: You can launch your charged explosions with your charged explosions. [Primary]
-----------------------
- **Pros** ✳️
-----------------------
 - **Destructive Knowledge**: Knowledge of bombs and other stuff is engraved in you allowing you to craft them in an ordinary crafting table
 - **Explosive Fall**: Falling higher than 10 blocks while sneaking causes enough force on your charged explosives to detonate themselves, saving you from the fall. 
 - **Materials Saver**: With your knowledge you can craft TNT with less materials.
 - **Resistant Skin**: All the exposure to the explosion led you to have strong bones which led you to be immune to Explosions. 
-----------------------
- **Cons** 🔴
-----------------------
 - **Ignition**: Your charged explosions explode when you are near a redstone block or are on fire.
 - **Wet Powder**: Gunpowder is unable to function when wet, preventing you from using your charged TNT. 
 - **Your Own way**:  Being a master of explosions you decided that using an elytra is to simple and that there is a better way.
 - **Better Craftsmanship**:  Knowing that there is an explosive better than one you can create leads you to destroy every end crystal you hold and being weaker near one.
--------
